```{=html}
<script>
function jsonFlickrFeed(data) {
  const container = document.getElementById('flickr-slideshow');
  const dotsWrap = document.getElementById('flickr-dots');
  container.innerHTML = '';
  dotsWrap.innerHTML = '';

  const photos = data.items.slice(0, 12);
  let current = 0;
  let timer;

  photos.forEach((item, i) => {
    // Imagen
    const slide = document.createElement('div');
    slide.className = 'flickr-slide' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.src = item.media.m.replace('_m.jpg', '_b.jpg'); // mejor calidad
    img.alt = item.title || 'Fotografía de David Niño';
    slide.appendChild(img);

    // Caption
    if (item.title) {
      const caption = document.createElement('div');
      caption.className = 'flickr-caption';
      caption.textContent = item.title;
      slide.appendChild(caption);
    }

    container.appendChild(slide);

    // Dot
    const dot = document.createElement('span');
    dot.className = 'flickr-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
    dot.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(i));
    dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
  });

  const slides = container.querySelectorAll('.flickr-slide');
  const dots = dotsWrap.querySelectorAll('.flickr-dot');

  function goTo(index) {
    slides[current].classList.remove('active');
    dots[current].classList.remove('active');
    current = index;
    slides[current].classList.add('active');
    dots[current].classList.add('active');
  }

  function next() {
    goTo((current + 1) % slides.length);
  }

  function start() {
    timer = setInterval(next, 5000);
  }
  function stop() {
    clearInterval(timer);
  }

  start();
  container.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
  container.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
}
</script>
<script async src="https://www.flickr.com/services/feeds/photos_public.gne?id=199852956@N06&format=json"></script>
```
